fusions.name: Buried Thread
fusions.desc: A heavy overhead blow that deals 30 damage, also deals 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Spoil Heap
fusions.desc: Heaves a cone of soil heaped on a cloth that deals 12 damage to everything in it and stuns it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Packed Earth
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Spadework
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you deal 25% more physical damage for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds. Your armour is 6% higher.
